questions.question_text: Based on the provided metadata header, what is the primary modality of the source content?
questions.explanation: The metadata explicitly states 'Audio Recording Voice' and 'VOICE_ONLY', indicating the content is purely auditory. Options A, C, and D are incorrect because they imply visual or textual components that are not present in the source description.

questions.misconception_rationale: Students may assume standard lectures include slides or text, leading them to select visual or mixed-media options.

questions.question_text: What is the stated reason why a factual summary of the engineering concepts could not be generated?
questions.option_a: The audio quality was too poor to transcribe
questions.option_b: The input chunks contained no specific educational text, definitions, formulas, or code examples
questions.option_c: The engineering concepts were classified as confidential
questions.option_d: The lecture was too short to contain substantive information
questions.explanation: The summary directly attributes the lack of a factual summary to the absence of 'specific educational text, definitions, formulas, or code examples' in the input chunks. Options A, C, and D introduce external factors (quality, confidentiality, length) that are not mentioned in the source text.
questions.what_taught: Linking cause (missing content) to effect (no summary)
questions.why_assessed: To test the ability to extract causal relationships directly from the provided text without inferring external causes.
questions.misconception_rationale: Students may assume technical issues (audio quality) or administrative issues (confidentiality) are the cause, rather than the explicit content deficiency stated.

questions.why_assessed: To verify precise reading comprehension of the negative constraints in the summary.
evidence_refs: Factual Summary: 'No specific educational text, definitions, formulas, or code examples...'
